{
  "title": "I.S.T.A.R Facilities",
  "language": "en",
  "recommended_level": "Woefully Unprepared 7th level characters",
  "hook": "A flashing light on a control board alerts the party to a 'Budget Overrun' in the I.S.T.A.R facility.",
  "npcs": [
    {
      "name": "Dread Lord Riavi",
      "role": "Designated temporary replacements for the Zhentarim members while Riavi is away."
    },
    {
      "name": "Guild Office Manager Kleff",
      "role": "Killed during the Harper agents' infiltration of the guild house."
    },
    {
      "name": "Emomel",
      "role": "Favored intern who died in an acid trap."
    },
    {
      "name": "Kleff",
      "role": "Flesh golem version of Guild Office Manager Kleff, encountered in the final challenge."
    }
  ],
  "locations": [
    "Intern Selection Training and Ranking facility",
    "Testing Room 1",
    "Testing Room 2",
    "Testing Room 3",
    "Testing Room 5",
    "Trust Falls, Performance Reviews, and Contract Negotiations Room"
  ],
  "threats": [
    "Flesh golem version of Guild Office Manager Kleff",
    "Spider-bees",
    "Spider-wolves",
    "Ghost sharks",
    "Skeletal interns",
    "Kleff (reanimated version)"
  ],
  "rewards": [
    "Medallions with the characters' names on them based on the value of what they turned in",
    "Gold construction paper star",
    "Dread Lord Riavi action figure",
    "Platinum piece from Dread Lord Riavi",
    "Trial negotiation with state-of-the-art Negotiator simulacrum"
  ]
}
